name: progineousgb/redirect-allow
description: Allowlist the host of a Laravel redirect target and fall back when it is not allowed.

suggest.illuminate/support: Optional. Registers the service provider, facade, validation rule, and redirect response on Laravel 12 and 13 (^12.0 || ^13.0). The decision engine does not need Laravel.
suggest.illuminate/http: Optional. Needed for PendingRedirect::send(), which returns an Illuminate redirect response (^12.0 || ^13.0).
suggest.illuminate/validation: Optional. Needed for the AllowedRedirect validation rule (^12.0 || ^13.0).
